mutants.name: v-drop-scope-gate
mutants.why: Thread 70: check (v) must be gated on test_scope starting 'none'. Without the scope guard the check fires on every QA step regardless of declared test scope, generating spurious WARNs for plans with real pytest coverage.
mutants.replacement: if True:  # mutant: scope gate dropped

mutants.name: v-invert-suppression
mutants.why: Thread 70: the suppression check fires when the clause IS present and stays silent when absent — the inverse of the intended direction. A plan that correctly pre-declares the class would still receive a WARN.
mutants.anchor: if "pre-declar" in _v_lower or "gate note" in _v_lower or "qa_test_result" in _v_lower:
mutants.replacement: if not ("pre-declar" in _v_lower or "gate note" in _v_lower or "qa_test_result" in _v_lower):

mutants.name: v-narrow-to-gate-name-token
mutants.why: Thread 70: narrowing the token set to qa_test_result alone regresses the 555 case — executable-555 carries a valid clause using pre-declar and gate note but not the gate-name token. That plan would receive a spurious WARN.
mutants.anchor: if "pre-declar" in _v_lower or "gate note" in _v_lower or "qa_test_result" in _v_lower:

mutants.name: v-widen-suppression-to-whole-plan
mutants.why: Thread 70: suppression must key on the QA STEP'S OWN text, not the whole plan. A plan that discusses the gate in a non-QA step (or its Why section) would silently suppress the WARN that the QA step earns.

mutants.name: v-drop-header-guard
mutants.why: Thread 70: the header guard prevents a KeyError when the plan header fails to parse (header is {}). Without it, any headerless plan raises on the dictionary key access, crashing the lint and silencing all downstream checks.

mutants.name: v-swap-gate-predicate
mutants.why: Thread 70 / P11: swapping the gate's own predicate for a keyword-in-step-text heuristic (the P11 defect) causes false positives. A non-QA step whose body mentions Rule 20 would be misclassified as QA and receive a spurious WARN.
mutants.replacement: if "qa" not in hl.lower() and "Rule 20" not in (gates._extract_step_text(plan_text, sn) or ""):

mutants.name: v-only-last-step
mutants.why: Thread 70 / cold scout S1-1: hoisting the check to run only on the last step (simulating the leaked-sn crash at wrong indent) causes the check to miss the QA step when it is not last. The first step's WARN is silently dropped.

mutants.name: v-append-as-fail
mutants.why: Thread 70 / P14: (v) is WARN-only and advisory — appending a FAIL to results and setting all_passed=False moves the exit code from 0 to 1, breaking run_check.judge_lint which reads the exit code as its only signal. A plan tripping (v) would be blocked from completing.
